11a_code.loc: keyword scan for github/release/code: no link

H1.sentence: probes achieve superior calibration compared to existing methods with ≈ 10x computational savings
H1.run_sd: said to be near zero, not reported

headline.H2: Probes consistently achieve the best calibration on PPE (Table 1: e.g. Llama 70B Kuiper 0.017 vs 0.135 verbalized), with 70-92% improvements over multi-generation methods for Llama (§4 p.5)

notes: Headline metrics (compute ratio, Kuiper, ECE) are not proportions, so the binomial survival models do not apply even though n is reported. The paper is itself about uncertainty of LLM judges.
